about: Package 8's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/80-overlays.mjs, scope overlays), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; so does a count that changes.

accepted.why: Deviation 10: the concept's Pedalboard carries a delegation signature (data-sig) the rebuild has no use for (the slice's accepted kind, on the board under the overlays).
Deviation 6: a knob says its value with its unit to a screen reader (the pedals' knobs under the overlays).
Deviation 6: every button says its type (the board's chain switch under the overlays, and the Lab offer's two buttons, deviation 40, and the lyric sheet's buttons on the desk under them, package 4).

The grip pressed to open its moves keeps its title: a press gives the hovered control's title back until the tip shows again (features/tooltips.ts, package 8's rule after its merge, bc0fd076: the concept's controls are redrawn by a press, title and all, so its knobs and tokens do the same there). The concept's grip is not redrawn by its press, so its tip keeps the title held; no tip shows on either page in this state.
